request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material and fur texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

A key ON THE SOFA. One ordinary silver metal house key on a plain metal ring lies in the middle of the seat cushion of a plain light-gray two-seat sofa that stands against a plain white wall on a wooden floor. The camera is close and a little above the seat, so the key is large enough to be clearly a key and the sofa's backrest and armrests are clearly visible around it. Nothing else is on the sofa: no cushions, no blanket, no phone, no people. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.
